name: Larkspur Yard
tagline: A converted print works with 60 desks, three meeting rooms and a very loud espresso machine.
hours: Members 07:00-22:00 daily. Day-pass guests 08:00-19:00, Monday to Friday.

desks.price: EUR 18 per day or EUR 190 per month
desks.notes: First come, first served; book a day ahead to guarantee a seat.
Your own desk and a lockable pedestal. One month minimum.
Third floor only. No calls, no keyboard clatter; bookable by the day.

booking: Desks and rooms are booked in the Larkspur app or by asking the front desk.
Rooms can be booked up to 30 days ahead, in 30-minute blocks.
Cancel a room at least 24 hours ahead for a full credit; later cancellations are charged at 50%.
Members get 4 free room hours per month; unused hours do not roll over.
rules: Phone calls and video calls happen in the call booths or meeting rooms, never on the open floor.
Food is fine at the kitchen tables; strong-smelling hot food (fish, curry) is kept to the ground-floor kitchen.
Bicycles live in the yard rack. Folding bikes may come upstairs.
Guests must be signed in at the front desk; members may sign in up to three guests a day.
Quiet hours on the third floor run all day.
